combined.note: Component savings are not additive; branches and GPU scheduling interact.

conclusions: Base relief and facets/creases are the two largest isolated measured Clay costs.
Fingerprints and dents/gouges/cracks are meaningful secondary costs.
Mottle is smaller but still measurable.
Clay-off scene cost stays near 11 ms across pixel ratios, while Clay-on cost falls strongly as resolution drops.
Clay cost is therefore substantially pixel-dependent but not pure fill-rate; distance gating and shader simplification remain necessary.
Absolute default fps varied from earlier runs, so use same-sequence relative deltas as the primary evidence.
nextPlainLanguage: Make distant Clay cheaper first: fade/skip invisible relief, facets and marks while keeping the near look unchanged.
